name: taube-markdown-tool
description: Markdown annotations, block editing, a text toolbar and a full fused mind-map canvas (.wmind/.xmind).

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node scripts/build-styles.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/enhancements.test.cjs tests/selection-tools.test.cjs tests/annotation-anchor.test.cjs tests/legacy-migration.test.cjs tests/block-drag.test.cjs tests/markdown-toolbar.test.cjs && node --test --import tsx tests/mindmap/clipboard.test.ts tests/mindmap/core.test.ts tests/mindmap/emoji-markers.test.ts tests/mindmap/fusion-format.test.ts tests/mindmap/fusion-ops.test.ts tests/mindmap/fusion-theme.test.ts tests/mindmap/inline-format.test.ts tests/mindmap/integration.test.ts tests/mindmap/lifetime.test.ts tests/mindmap/note-modal.test.ts tests/mindmap/obsidian-host.test.ts tests/mindmap/obsidian-plugin.test.ts tests/mindmap/obsidian-xmind.test.ts tests/mindmap/persistence.test.ts tests/mindmap/rich-export.test.ts tests/mindmap/rich.test.ts tests/mindmap/shape.test.ts tests/mindmap/summary-branch.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: node tests/ui-test.cjs && node tests/selection-ui-test.cjs && node tests/drag-ui.cjs && node tests/toolbar-ui.cjs && node tests/mindmap-ui.cjs

author: taube
